_comment: FocusMode allowed tools and Bash commands per state. Story: focusmode-fsm
_protocol: block_on_violation: exit 2 + stdout reason. Allowed actions exit 0.
_note: Bash patterns use POSIX ERE (bash =~ operator). Use [[:space:]] not \s. No \b needed.

TAKE._comment: Claim a todo. Task management tools, ToolSearch (to load them), and specific bash commands.

warn_on.non_task_tool: Use 'todo take <id>' (Bash) or Task tools (TaskList/TaskUpdate) to claim work before writing code
warn_on.bash_not_allowed: Run 'todo avail' to find work, then 'todo <id> take' to claim it (or TaskUpdate if using harness tasks)

BRANCH._comment: Create a git feature branch. Git branch commands only.

warn_on.write_edit_tool: Create a git branch before writing files

SEARCH._comment: Search heuristics/specs/memory before writing code. rag search required to advance.

warn_on.write_edit_tool: Search heuristics and memory before writing anything — run 'rag search "<task>"' first
warn_on.bash_not_allowed: In SEARCH state: run 'rag search "<task description>"' to consult the heuristics library

SPEC._comment: Write spec/story before writing tests. Research allowed. Source/test writes blocked.

warn_on.write_outside_specs: Write spec/story files in specs/ or stories/ before advancing — document what you're building and why
warn_on.bash_not_allowed: Expected: todo or read-only git commands in SPEC state

TEST._comment: Write failing tests. tests/ is canonical. specs/stories allowed for updates during test writing. Source paths blocked.

warn_on.write_outside_tests: Write tests in tests/ before advancing — use tests/ as the canonical test directory
warn_on.bash_not_test_runner: Run your test suite to confirm tests fail before writing code

CODE._comment: Make tests pass. Write anywhere allowed. No restrictions.

REVIEW._comment: Verify code quality: tests pass, linter clean. Read-only — no file writes.

warn_on.write_edit_tool: REVIEW is read-only — go back to CODE state if changes are needed
warn_on.bash_not_allowed: Expected: test runner or read-only git commands in REVIEW state

DOC._comment: Update documentation. Write only in doc directories.

warn_on.write_outside_docs: Update docs/stories/specs before advancing — write to a doc directory
warn_on.bash_not_doc: Expected: git operations or doc tooling

AUDIT._comment: Haiku agent verifies spec→test→code→doc order. Read-only git introspection.

warn_on.write_edit_tool: AUDIT is read-only — no file changes during workflow audit
warn_on.bash_not_allowed: Expected: git history inspection or focusmode-audit in AUDIT state

COMPLETE._comment: Mark todo done. Only TaskUpdate and specific bash commands.

warn_on.non_task_tool: Mark the todo as completed with TaskUpdate before advancing
warn_on.bash_not_allowed: Use TaskUpdate to mark work complete

COMMIT._comment: Commit changes. Git add/commit via Bash only.

warn_on.write_edit_tool: Commit with Bash (git add + git commit) — no more file writes in COMMIT state

MERGE._comment: Merge to main, clean up branch. Git merge/checkout via Bash only.

warn_on.write_edit_tool: Merge with Bash (git checkout main + git merge) — no file writes in MERGE state
warn_on.bash_not_git_merge: Expected: git checkout main && git merge <branch> && git branch -d <branch>
